hero.title: Income management that preserves capital
hero.subtitle: Australian fixed income for investors who want steady income without putting their capital in harm's way. Public funds, wholesale portfolios and private mandates, run with the same discipline for over three decades.

cards.title: Fixed Income Fund
cards.subtitle: Australian sovereign and senior bank bonds, managed for income and capital stability.

cards.title: Preferred Income Fund
cards.subtitle: Australian government and corporate credit, managed for higher income than cash and traditional fixed interest.

leftRight.title: How we invest
leftRight.body: Capital preservation comes first. We hold investment grade bonds issued under Australian law, in Australian dollars, and set duration by where we are in the rate cycle rather than by an index. Income comes from getting that read right, not from moving down the credit curve.

leftRight.title: Independent oversight
leftRight.body: Arculus makes the investment decisions but does not hold, value or administer the assets. Four parties are involved in every transaction. Three of them are independent of us.

cards.title: Arculus Wholesale strategies
cards.subtitle: SMA mandates in senior bank and insurer credit, and a protected equity strategy. For wholesale clients within the meaning of ss 708 and 761G.
